title: Josh Gad to Join Margot Robbie and Bradley Cooper’s ‘Ocean’s’ Prequel (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
Josh Gad is the latest to joinMargot RobbieandBradley Cooper‘s crew for their forthcoming “Ocean’s 11” prequel at Warner Bros, sources toldVariety.

Gad has booked a significant role in the period heist film, the sources added, and joins a starry ensemble led by Robbie and her director-costar Cooper. Casting has been coming at a steady clip as the film heads toward production. Reps for Gad and Warner Bros. Pictures did not immediately respond toVariety‘s request for comment.

Since the original 1960 film, “Ocean’s 11” — which starred Rat Pack members Frank Sinatra, Sammy Davis Jr., Joey Bishop, Peter Lawford and Dean Martin — the high-class heist movie franchise has attracted A-list and award-winning talent. Warners’ latest installment is no exception, with Oscar nomineesWagner Moura(“The Secret Agent”), who is set to play the villain, and Monica Barbaro (“A Complete Unknown”) also signing on to the cast.

Gad adds the “Oceans” prequel to a schedule that includes the anticipated “Space Balls: The New One” from Paramount Pictures, sequels to the animated franchises “Angry Birds” and “Frozen,” and the feature adaptation of “Oh, The Places You Will Go” with Ariana Grande. He also recently re-upped his overall TV deal with 20th Century Television.

Details about the “Ocean’s” prequel film have been scarce, but Robbie confirmed a few key points during the studio’s CinemaCon presentation this spring.

“Before Danny Ocean ever stepped foot in Vegas, two masterminds taught him everything he knows — his parents,” Robbie teased, referencing the con-man and ringleader of the Las Vegas casino caper in “Ocean’s 11.” “You’ll see them in their prime, and in our new movie, pulling off an epic heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix.”

Further plot details are “locked in the vault,” but Cooper wrote the screenplay and is directing the film, dated for release on June 25, 2027. He is also producing the project alongside LuckyChap, the company led by Tom Ackerley, Josey McNamara, Milan Popelka and Robbie.

Executive producers for the “Ocean’s” prequel include McNamara, Bronte Payne, Bobby Wilhelm, Jay Roach, Michelle Graham, Lee Isaac Chung, Ashley Jay Sandberg, Gary Ross and Olivia Milch. The untitled film is based on characters created by George Clayton Johnson and Jack Golden Russell. Carrie Solomon handled previous drafts of the screenplay.

The Steven Soderbergh-directed “Ocean’s Eleven” trilogy, starring George Clooney, Matt Damon, Brad Pitt and Julia Roberts, plus the “Ocean’s Eight” reboot with Sandra Bullock, Cate Blanchett, Anne Hathaway and Rihanna, have earned more than $1.4 billion at the global box office.

Gad is repped by WME, Range Media Partners, PJ Shapiro and imPRint.
title_zh: 喬什·蓋德(Josh Gad)將加入瑪格·羅比(Margot Robbie)和布萊德利·庫珀(Bradley Cooper)的《海洋的前傳》(Ocean’s Prequel)中（獨家報導）。
content_zh:
喬什·蓋德(Josh Gad)是最新加入瑪格·羅比(Margot Robbie)和布萊德·皮特(Bradley Cooper)陣容的演員，參與他們即將在華納兄弟(Warner Bros)製作的《海洋之十一(Ocean’s 11)》前傳，消息來源告訴《綜藝(Variety)》。

消息來源補充說，蓋德在這部時代搶劫電影中預定了重要角色，並加入了由羅比和她的導演兼搭檔皮特領銜的星光熠熠的陣容。隨著電影進入製作階段，選角工作也在穩步推進。蓋德和華納兄弟影業(Warner Bros. Pictures)的代表尚未立即回應《綜藝》的評論請求。

自1960年原版電影《海洋之十一(Ocean’s 11)》以來，該片由拉特包(Rat Pack)成員弗蘭克·西納特拉(Frank Sinatra)、薩米·戴維斯(Jr. Sammy Davis)、喬伊·比肖普(Joey Bishop)、彼得·勞福德(Peter Lawford)和迪恩·馬丁(Dean Martin)主演，高端搶劫電影系列吸引了眾多A級和獲獎人才。華納兄弟的最新一部作品也不例外，奧斯卡提名者瓦格納·莫拉(Wagner Moura)將出演反派角色，而莫妮卡·巴巴羅(Monica Barbaro)也加入了演員陣容。

蓋德將《海洋之十一(Ocean’s)》前傳加入他的日程中，還包括派拉蒙影業(Paramount Pictures)期待已久的《太空球：新篇(Space Balls: The New One)》，動畫系列《憤怒的小鳥(Angry Birds)》和《冰雪奇緣(Frozen)》的續集，以及改編自《哦，你將去的地方(Oh, The Places You Will Go)》的電影，與阿莉安娜·格蘭德(Ariana Grande)合作。他最近還與20世紀電視(20th Century Television)續簽了整體電視合約。

有關《海洋之十一(Ocean’s)》前傳電影的細節仍然稀少，但羅比在春季的電影展(CinemaCon)上確認了一些關鍵點。

“在丹尼·奧申(Danny Ocean)踏足拉斯維加斯之前，兩位策劃者教會了他所有的知識——他的父母，”羅比調侃道，提到《海洋之十一(Ocean’s 11)》中的詐騙者和拉斯維加斯賭場陰謀的首腦。“你將看到他們的巔峰時期，在我們的新電影中，他們在1962年摩納哥大獎賽上策劃了一場史詩般的搶劫。”

進一步的情節細節“被鎖在保險庫中”，但皮特撰寫了劇本並執導該片，定於2027年6月25日上映。他還與LuckyChap公司共同製作該項目，該公司由湯姆·阿克利(Tom Ackerley)、喬西·麥克納馬拉(Josey McNamara)、米蘭·波佩爾卡(Milan Popelka)和羅比領導。

《海洋之十一(Ocean’s)》前傳的執行製片人包括麥克納馬拉、布朗特·佩恩(Bronte Payne)、鮑比·威爾海姆(Bobby Wilhelm)、傑伊·羅奇(Jay Roach)、米歇爾·格雷厄姆(Michelle Graham)、李·艾薩克·鄭(Lee Isaac Chung)、阿什莉·傑·桑德伯格(Ashley Jay Sandberg)、加里·羅斯(Gary Ross)和奧利維亞·米爾赫(Olivia Milch)。這部未命名的電影基於喬治·克萊頓·約翰遜(George Clayton Johnson)和傑克·戈爾登·拉塞爾(Jack Golden Russell)創造的人物。凱莉·所羅門(Carrie Solomon)負責之前的劇本草稿。

史蒂文·索德伯格(Steven Soderbergh)執導的《海洋之十一(Ocean’s Eleven)》三部曲，主演包括喬治·克魯尼(George Clooney)、馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)、布萊德·皮特和茱莉亞·羅伯茨(Julia Roberts)，以及與桑德拉·布洛克(Sandra Bullock)、凱特·布蘭琪(Cate Blanchett)、安妮·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)和蕾哈娜(Rihanna)合作的《海洋之八(Ocean’s Eight)》重啟版，全球票房超過14億美元。

蓋德由WME、Range Media Partners、PJ Shapiro和imPRint代理。

消息來源補充說，蓋德在這部時代搶劫電影中預定了重要角色，並加入了由羅比和她的導演兼搭檔皮特領銜的星光熠熠的陣容。
